body:
## Problem

The complete v0.91.7 closed-issue audit found that typed `csdlc-closeout reconcile-terminal` correctly relocates retained design artifacts to `.csdlc/issues/<issue>/retained/` and updates the index, SPP, and VPP references, but it does not normalize SOR artifact references.

For #5390, the reconciled closed-out projection deletes `.csdlc/issues/5390/diagram.mmd` while `cards/sor.values.json` and rendered `sor.md` still reference that deleted path. The byte-identical artifact exists at `.csdlc/issues/5390/retained/diagram.mmd`.

## Impact

A typed terminal reconciliation can pass `csdlc-doctor` while leaving a broken durable artifact reference in SOR. Manual card editing is forbidden, and the current terminal design/plan-step repair routes do not own SOR artifact normalization.

## Acceptance criteria

- Extend the typed terminal reconciliation or a narrowly authorized terminal repair command to normalize SOR artifact references when authored artifacts move to retained paths.
- Update values first and regenerate rendered SOR plus all affected digests atomically.
- Update the retained terminal receipt and local projection under the shared terminal transaction lock.
- Fail closed on stale generation, digest, receipt, or mismatched artifact bytes.
- Add a regression proving no generated card references a deleted pre-retention design/diagram path.
- Repair #5390 through the new typed route and re-run bounded closeout review.
- Do not manually patch generated cards or use sunset v1 tooling.
- No AWS validation is required.

## Evidence

- Failing projection: `.csdlc/issues/5390/cards/sor.values.json`
- Deleted path: `.csdlc/issues/5390/diagram.mmd`
- Retained path: `.csdlc/issues/5390/retained/diagram.mmd`
- Typed reconciliation updates index/SPP/VPP but not SOR artifacts.
title: [v0.91.8][csdlc-v2][closeout] Normalize SOR artifact refs during terminal reconciliation
